# ShowOnce

<!-- Generated from the doc comments in the library. Do not edit this file. -->

Renders its child on the document's first page only.

The canonical use is a page template that should not repeat: a cover-page watermark, a one-off notice above a running header. Inside body flow, where an element is reached once anyway, it renders normally on page 1 and disappears if the flow has already carried it past it.

Import from `@bonniepdf/core`. Extends `PaginationWrapperBase`.

## Constructors

```typescript
new ShowOnce()
new ShowOnce(options: ShowOnceOptions)
new ShowOnce(child: IElement)
```
